name: Smoothness Regularization
definition: A training loss applied to enforce local smoothness on the 2D grid of sorted Gaussians, exploiting the fact that different Gaussian configurations can yield similar visual quality while varying in smoothness, thereby aiding compression.
summary: Smoothness Regularization is a training-time loss for 3D Gaussian Splatting that enforces local smoothness on 2D attribute grids to improve compressibility without degrading rendering quality.
